// Windows may deny ancestor metadata even when the configured folder is readable.
const fs = require("node:fs");
const pathApi = require("node:path");
const { fileURLToPath } = require("node:url");

const originalRealpathSync = fs.realpathSync;
const key = (path) =>
  pathApi.toNamespacedPath(pathApi.resolve(path)).toLowerCase();
const roots = new Set(
  [
    pathApi.dirname(process.argv[1]),
    ...(process.env.NODE_REPL_NODE_MODULE_DIRS ?? "")
      .split(pathApi.delimiter)
      .map((entry) => entry.trim()),
    ...(process.env.NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_CODE_PATHS ?? "")
      .split(pathApi.delimiter)
      .filter(pathApi.isAbsolute),
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(key),
);

fs.realpathSync = function realpathSync(path, options) {
  try {
    // Preserve Node's canonical paths (including short names and links) when possible.
    return originalRealpathSync.native(path, options);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code !== "EPERM" && error.code !== "EACCES") {
      throw error;
    }
    // MXC can deny native final-path lookup even when the file is readable.
    try {
      return originalRealpathSync(path, options);
    } catch (fallbackError) {
      if (fallbackError.code !== "EPERM" && fallbackError.code !== "EACCES") {
        throw fallbackError;
      }
    }
    if (path instanceof URL) {
      path = fileURLToPath(path);
    }
    if (Buffer.isBuffer(path)) {
      path = path.toString();
    }

    const filename = pathApi.resolve(path);
    // Only accept paths below a configured root. A junction or symlink could
    // point outside that root, so it must not receive the lexical fallback.
    for (let current = filename; ; current = pathApi.dirname(current)) {
      if (fs.lstatSync(current).isSymbolicLink()) {
        throw error;
      }
      if (roots.has(key(current))) {
        const encoding =
          typeof options === "string" ? options : options?.encoding;
        const buffer = Buffer.from(filename);
        return encoding === "buffer"
          ? buffer
          : buffer.toString(encoding ?? "utf8");
      }
      if (pathApi.dirname(current) === current) {
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }
};
fs.realpathSync.native = fs.realpathSync;

// --eval leaves the script at argv[1]. Use Node's ordinary main-module loader
// so argv, require.main, and relative imports keep their normal meaning.
require("node:module").runMain();
